bullets: formar el past perfect con had + participio

usar by the time, already, before y after
reconocer el past perfect continuous (had been waiting)

blocks.label: verbo irregular
examples: I had already left when she called.
Ya me había ido cuando llamó.
You had left your keys at home.
Te habías dejado las llaves en casa.
The train had left by the time we arrived.
El tren ya había salido cuando llegamos.
We had left before the rain started.
Nos habíamos ido antes de que empezara a llover.
You had left the door open.
Os habíais dejado la puerta abierta.

blocks.text: El past perfect es siempre had, para todas las personas, como había. La forma corta es 'd: I'd seen, she'd gone. La negación es hadn't.
Cuentas el pasado en past simple. Si quieres mostrar que algo ya había pasado antes, usas el past perfect.

head: Inglés
Orden
rows: When I arrived, the film had started.
primero empezó la película, luego llegué yo
When I arrived, the film started.
llegué, y entonces empezó la película
She was nervous because she had never flown before.
nunca había volado antes de ese momento
I didn't recognise him. He had grown a beard.
la barba ya estaba allí

blocks.title: Como el pluscuamperfecto español
blocks.text: Es el mismo tiempo que había visto: Ya lo había visto = I had already seen it. Pero el inglés es más estricto: donde el español a veces se conforma con el indefinido (Cuando llegué, la película ya empezó), el inglés necesita el past perfect: the film had already started.

blocks.title: No hace falta si el orden ya está claro
blocks.text: Después de after o before el orden ya está claro, así que también vale el past simple: After she finished (o had finished) her work, she went home.

Con had been + -ing dices cuánto tiempo llevabas haciendo algo antes de un momento del pasado: When the bus finally came, we had been waiting for an hour. (Llevábamos una hora esperando.) She was tired because she had been working all day.

rows: When we arrived, the train has left.
When we arrived, the train had left.
Antes de un momento del pasado: had.
He already went home when I arrived.
He had already gone home when I arrived.
El past perfect va siempre con had.
I didn't know her because I never met her before.
I didn't know her because I had never met her before.
Antes de ese momento: past perfect.
She had went to bed.
She had gone to bed.
Después de had va el participio.
We were waiting for an hour when the bus came.
We had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
Cuánto tiempo llevabas: had been + -ing.

blocks.text: Completa con el past simple o el past perfect. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: When I got to the station, the train ______.
items.full: When I got to the station, the train had left.

items.q: She ______ never seen snow before she moved to Canada.
items.full: She had never seen snow before she moved to Canada.

items.q: I didn't recognise him. He ______ a lot.
items.full: I didn't recognise him. He had changed a lot.

items.q: By the time we arrived, the party ______.
items.full: By the time we arrived, the party had finished.

items.q: They ______ tired because they had walked all day.
items.full: They were tired because they had walked all day.

items.q: We ______ eaten, so we weren't hungry.
items.full: We had already eaten, so we weren't hungry.

items.q: He couldn't pay because he ______ his wallet.
items.full: He couldn't pay because he had lost his wallet.

items.q: We had ______ waiting for two hours when the doctor called us.
items.full: We had been waiting for two hours when the doctor called us.

items.q: I ______ seen the film, so I didn't go.
items.full: I had seen the film, so I didn't go.

items.q: She told me she ______ in Spain before.
items.full: She told me she had never lived in Spain before.

items.q: Cuando llegué, la película ya había empezado.
items.a: When I arrived, the film had already started.

items.q: Él ya se había ido a casa.

items.a: I had never seen her before.
We had been waiting for an hour.
